main_text.p: in infulas,& stagna exiccabo.Et ducam cæ cos per uiam quam nescierunt, & per semi tas quas non cognouerūt faciam eosince-dere:ponamq; tenebras coram eis in lucem, & obliqua in planum: secūdum hæc uerba feci eis, & non dereliqui eos. Acti sunt retrorsum, confundentur cofusione, qui con-fidunt in sculptili, & qui dicunt ad conflati le, Vos dij nostri. O surdi audite: & cæci respicite ut uideatis. Quis est cæcus nisi seruus meus, & surdus sicut nūcius meus, quē missurus sum ? Quis est cæcus (aiunt) sicut perfectus, & cęcus sicut seruus Domini? Vidisti multa, & non obseruas: apertę sunt aures, & nemo audit. Dominus pius est propter iustitiam suam, magnificat legem atq; sublimat. Et ipse populus direptus & conculcatus, illaqueatur in cauernis, omnes inquam ipsi & in locis carceralibus abscon-diti sunt: fuerunt in direptionem nemine liberante, & in conculcationem, nemine dicente, Restitue (prædam.) Quis ex uobis auribus percipiet istud, aduertet & attendet in posterum? Quis dedit Iacob in conculcationem, & Israelem in direptorum (manus?) nonne Dominus? eo quòd peccauerimus contra eum, & non uoluerunt

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Several words underlined in the printed text (e.g. "Quis"); underlining not reproduced. "perfeftus" printed with a ligature-like "ft"; read as perfectus, doubtful. "quē" with tilde is uncertain. "(manus?)" is printed with a question mark. "eosince-dere:ponamq;" and "cofusione" are printed as shown, with no correction. The O of "O surdi" is preceded by a small mark, read as an apostrophe and omitted. No marginal notes, no printed footnotes. Page is a continuation, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true".
